# Skinpal

> Skinpal is a mobile app for people living with topical steroid withdrawal (TSW) and eczema. Users log mood, symptoms on a body map, sleep, stress, food and photos in about 30 seconds a day, and the app turns those logs into weekly summaries so they can see what changed over time. It also has a community for people going through the same thing. Skinpal does not give medical advice, diagnose or recommend treatment.

## Key facts

- Made by TSW Nordic AB, Gothenburg, Sweden.
- Founded by Lukas Löfgren, who has lived with TSW since January 2022 and shares his story on Instagram as @tswlukas (40,000+ followers across platforms).
- Platforms: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play).
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- Price: 14-day free trial, then $3.99 per month or $39.99 per year (USD).
- Data: encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS. Never sold. Users can delete their account and health data at any time.
- Who it is for: adults with topical steroid withdrawal, eczema (atopic dermatitis) or similar long-running skin conditions who want a simple daily record to look back on and share with their doctor.

## Main features

- Daily log in about 30 seconds: mood, symptoms and where they flare on a body map, sleep, stress, food, notes and photos.
- Weekly summaries and patterns built from the user's own logs, to answer "is it better than last month?"
- Community spaces for TSW, for parents and for the emotional side of living with a skin condition.
- More features are being added.
